parsed.why: No criminalisation, constitutional equality guarantee, no documented visitor-facing exposure, no trans-specific targeting. Stigma is dated and friction-level; gender-identity reach of the guarantee is an open question, not an exposure. Thin but structurally benign record.

State-engineered universal exposure: birth-sex passport regime, visa fraud-refusal instructions, facility bans across many states with criminal trespass in four, arrest and men's-ward holding, conversion-style custody policy, immigration abuse, official threat-framing. Courts partly push back.

Self-determination facility access, official tourism acceptance, most-trans-supportive survey, court applying the transphobia aggravation and sentencing attackers. Only regional rollbacks and conservative attitudes outside cities; no visitor-facing restriction documented.

Decriminalised since 2014, no trans-specific penalty or documented targeting. But also no anti-discrimination protection, constitutional marriage bar, and a silent record offering neither acceptance evidence nor relief mechanisms; extrapolates to benign-but-unprotected.

Authorities apply a vagrancy law treating homosexuality as illness; collective police detentions, public shaming, arrest of an organiser with subsequent crackdown, trans women sexually abused in police custody, rape impunity where perpetrators are police. State-tolerated targeting.
